messages.text: How do changes in Wi-Fi 7/8 technology affect the measurement capability required from Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer?

### Answer
The required Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer capability expands mainly in bandwidth, multi-chain/MIMO handling, signaling/real-connection analysis, and feature-specific Wi‑Fi 8 reliability analysis; the passages do not support treating 480 MHz as a formal Wi‑Fi 8 requirement [10][12][57][58][59][66].
| Technology change | Effect on SG / SA measurement capability | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Wi‑Fi 7 increases channel bandwidth to 320 MHz and uses 4096QAM, up to 16 spatial streams, and MLO | SG/SA needs to handle 320 MHz WLAN signals, high-order modulation analysis/generation, and multi-RF-chain / MIMO test setups rather than only single-chain narrowband WLAN testing | Wi‑Fi 7 key elements include 320 MHz channel bandwidth, up to 16 spatial streams, 4096QAM, and MLO; the source says MLO makes a multiple RF chains test environment important [12]. |
| Wi‑Fi 7 R&D testing moves toward signaling mode under real-world conditions | Analyzer/generator platforms need signaling-mode TX/RX RF measurement capability, not only waveform playback or offline analysis | Wi‑Fi 7 R&D testing needs signaling mode and real-world conditions to measure RF TX/RX characteristics [10]. |
| Wi‑Fi 7 production testing emphasizes speed in non-signaling mode | Production SG/SA capability needs fast non-signaling RF measurement, scalable analyzers/generators, RF port density, and MIMO scaling | In production, all RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time; CMP180 is described with two analyzers, two generators, two sets of eight RF ports for 2x2 MIMO, and two CMP180 units can scale to four analyzers/generators for 4x4 MIMO AP testing [67]. |
| Wi‑Fi 8 adds reliability-oriented PHY/MAC features such as dRU and UEQM | Analyzer capability must include feature-specific signaling analysis: dRU measurements for uplink transmit power boost / reliability behavior and UEQM analysis for per-MIMO-link modulation and specified MCS-combination adaptation | dRU measurements verify uplink transmit power boost and connection reliability improvement; UEQM analysis evaluates whether the device correctly adapts modulation according to specified MCS combinations [59][66]. |
| Early Wi‑Fi 8 discussion included a 480 MHz WLAN waveform candidate | 480 MHz / 500 MHz-class bandwidth is only an R&D or future-proofing consideration in the cited material, not a confirmed Wi‑Fi 8 conformance requirement | CMP180 was said to support bandwidths up to 500 MHz and demonstrate a 480 MHz WLAN waveform in loopback mode as a potential Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn candidate, but the passage says this must not be treated as a formal Wi‑Fi 8 standard channel bandwidth [57]. |
【推論】For Wi‑Fi 7/8 baseband/RF work, the practical SG/SA bandwidth floor moves to 320 MHz, while 480 MHz should be treated only as exploratory because Wi‑Fi 7 lists 320 MHz and Wi‑Fi 8 retains up to 320 MHz, whereas 480 MHz is only a potential candidate waveform [12][58][57].
【推論】For MLO and MIMO work, SG/SA setups need multiple synchronized RF chains or scalable analyzer/generator resources because Wi‑Fi 7 identifies MLO as making multiple RF chains important, and production testing cites 2x2 and scalable 4x4 analyzer/generator configurations [10][67].
【推論】For Wi‑Fi 8, the added measurement burden is less about a proven wider channel and more about signaling analysis of reliability features, because the cited Wi‑Fi 8 passages retain 320 MHz but add dRU and UEQM measurement/analysis requirements [58][59][66].

Wi-Fi 8 › 來源中的技術定位
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]：

- [[IEEE 802.11bn]] amendment introduces advancements focused on consistent, high-quality connectivity across dense environments。
- 目標應用包含 growing number of connected devices、VR/AR、8K streaming、industrial IoT。
- [[Wi-Fi 8]] builds upon [[Wi-Fi 7]] foundation。
- 來源明示 final IEEE standard ratification 尚未完成；[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的測試是在 ratification 前展示。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 在 MWC 2024 語境下仍是 yet-to-be-defined standard。
- 來源稱 even wider channel bandwidths are in discussion。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform loopback mode verification，並稱該 waveform 是 [[Wi-Fi 8]] potential waveform candidate。

Wi-Fi 8 › 使用限制
- 本頁目前由 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]、[[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 與 [[WiFi8]] 支撐。
- [[WiFi8]] 是 OneNote link hub，不是文章正文、datasheet、configuration guide、IEEE standard text 或 certification document。
- PR / demonstration statement 不等同於 IEEE standard text、datasheet、configuration guide 或 certification document。
- 來源未標示 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] draft version、standard version、final ratification date 或 IEEE document number。
- 來源未列出完整 [[Wi-Fi 8]] PHY / MAC feature set、band plan、regulatory conditions、test requirements 或 interoperability criteria。
- 480 MHz waveform 僅能記為 MWC 2024 PR 中的 potential candidate，不可寫成 Wi-Fi 8 正式規格。
- 320 MHz channel bandwidth 僅能記為較晚 R&S / Broadcom PR 對 retained core PHY parameter 的說法，不可替代 IEEE 802.11bn 正式文件。
- 不可從 [[WiFi8]] 的連結標題推論 [[Broadcom]]、[[MediaTek]]、[[ASUS]] 或 [[Filogic 8000]] 的產品規格、上市時間、供應關係或認證狀態。

Wi-Fi 8 › CES 2026 外部待讀連結
[[WiFi8]]（raw converted 2026-09-17）是 OneNote link hub，列出與 [[CES 2026]]、[[Broadcom]]、[[ASUS]]、[[MediaTek]]、[[Filogic 8000]] 與 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 相關的外部文章連結。該來源只提供連結標題與 URL，未擷取正文，因此目前只能支撐 [[Wi-Fi 8 外部資料清單]]，不能作為標準內容、晶片規格、路由器展示或量產時程的證據。

可追溯的連結線索包括：

- Tom's Hardware 標題提到 [[Broadcom]] two dual-band [[Wi-Fi 8]] chips。
- TechNews / The Verge 標題提到 [[Wi-Fi 8]] router / CES before most users have switched to [[Wi-Fi 7]]。
- RCR Wireless 標題提到 [[MediaTek]] previews [[Filogic 8000]] at [[CES 2026]]。
- EDN 標題提到 [[Wi-Fi 8]] silicon 與 AI touch。
- Network World 標題提到 [[Wi-Fi 8]] prioritizes reliability over speed gains。

以上均為待讀線索，不新增本頁的技術規格主張。

Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology › 架構與用途
來源中的 WoMT 架構可整理為：

1. 產生或處理 native [[Wi-Fi 7]] / IEEE 802.11be signal。
2. 透過 [[AiP]] / antenna-in-package module 執行 integrated antenna 與 up-conversion。
3. 將信號搬移到 27 GHz mmWave band，來源以 n257 / n258 表示。
4. 用於 Integrated Radio CPEs 與 WoMT-AP。
5. 在 RD / manufacturing setup 中分成 WIFI IB band 與 WIFI mmWave path。
6. 透過 OTA / RF test 確認 EVM、[[EIRP]]、[[TRP]]、[[ACLR]]、[[EIS]]、occupied bandwidth 與 Rx / OOB spurious emissions。

Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology › 測試需求
依 [[R&S for JIO Project]] 與 [[R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3]]，WoMT 測試至少包含：

- OTA precision measurement：使用 [[R&S ATS1800C]] CATR chamber。
- TX analysis：[[EIRP]]、[[TRP]]、[[ACLR]]、EVM under Wi-Fi 7 modulation。
- RX analysis：[[EIS]] sensitivity verification。
- Spurious：Rx / OOB spurious emissions monitoring。
- Occupied bandwidth。
- Native Wi-Fi / IF / IB band：[[R&S CMP180]]。
- mmWave signal generation and analysis：[[R&S CMP200]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]]。
- R&D fine tuning：[[R&S FSW67]] 與 signal sources。
- Production / manufacturing setup：[[R&S CMQ200]] 與 automation SW WMT 只作為來源列名，尚無詳細流程。

[[R&S for JIO Project]] 把 WoMT 的核心挑戰描述為 bridging the gap between IEEE and 3GPP：

- IEEE / Wi-Fi side：[[Wi-Fi 7]]、802.11be、native Wi-Fi signal、IF / IB band testing。
- 3GPP side：n257 / n258、27 GHz mmWave band、FR2 / mmWave-related test items。

- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

- 來源正式日期未標示；slide 4 仍保留 `MM/DD/YYYY` placeholder，slide 21 標示 `Q1/2024 CMP180 News`，但整份簡報的正式發布日期與專案期間未標示。

- 核心技術問題：[[Wi-Fi 7]] 原生運作於 2.4 / 5 / 6 GHz，而 27 GHz、n257 / n258 屬 [[3GPP]] mmWave bands；來源稱全球缺乏 Wi-Fi operating in mmWave bands 的既有 test standards。

- [[Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology]] 架構：透過 [[AiP]] modules 將 [[Wi-Fi 7]] signals up-convert 到 27 GHz mmWave band，用於 high-speed transmission；device types 包含 Integrated Radio CPEs 與 WoMT-AP（Access Point）。

EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap › 重點摘要
- [[EMITE]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 繼續合作，enhance [[EMITE]] 的 [[OTA testing]] measurement solutions。
- 合作內容是 fully integrating the latest test capabilities of [[R&S CMX500]] multi-technology、multi-channel one-box signaling tester。
- 來源稱整合後除了支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]] 與 [[NR FR2]]，也支援 full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] / [[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G RedCap]]。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為支援 cellular technologies，包括 [[LTE]]、[[5G NR]] [[NR FR1]] frequency range up to 8 GHz、[[NR FR2]] millimeter wave frequency range up to 50 GHz，以及 latest [[5G RedCap]] technology。
- 同一來源也說 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援 non-cellular technologies，包括 latest [[Wi-Fi 7]]，all in a single instrument。
- 對 [[EMITE]] customers 的價值是取得 comprehensive environment，用於 accurately assessing the performance of [[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G RedCap]] devices。
- 下一步合作方向是 integrating test capabilities for [[NB-IoT NTN]] 與 [[NR NTN]]；來源稱這些能力 already covered by [[R&S CMW500]] and [[R&S CMX500]]。
- 來源用背景段落說明 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 具 tens of gigabits per second、low latency，面向 ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality。
- 來源定義 [[RedCap]] 為 [[3GPP Release 17]] 的 5G technology，是 reduced-functionality version of 5G，相較 [[5G eMBB]] 成本顯著較低，具 mid-range data throughput、low power consumption、low complexity 與支援大量 devices 的能力，特別適合 [[IoT]] applications。
- [[David A. Sánchez-Hernández]] 以 [[EMITE]] CEO 身分表示，EMITE 將 testing chambers 升級到搭配 [[R&S CMX500]]，使 customers 可 extend capabilities to include [[IEEE 802.11be]] standard 與 Red Cap devices。
- [[Christoph Pointner]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Senior Vice President of Mobile Radio Testers 身分表示，將 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 整合進 [[EMITE]] OTA chambers portfolio，可支援 latest technologies 的 reliability 與 efficiency 測試。

Reverberation chamber OTA testing › 在 Wi-Fi 7 測試中的角色
本來源將 reverberation chamber OTA testing 放在 [[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]] 的情境中：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 提供 [[Wi-Fi 7]] signaling / test functionality。
- [[Bluetest Flow]] 作為 control software / integrated test environment。
- [[Bluetest]] RTS / reverberation chambers 提供 realistic multipath OTA environment。
- 測試對象包含 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points。

Reverberation chamber OTA testing
[[Reverberation chamber OTA testing]] 是在會大量反射 RF signal 的 chamber 中進行 over-the-air 測試，藉由形成 [[Rayleigh faded multipath RF environment]] 來評估 wireless devices 的 antenna and radio performance。

Reverberation chamber OTA testing › 使用限制
- 本頁只記錄來源對 reverberation chamber OTA testing 的描述，不補推完整 OTA test standard、calibration method 或 measurement uncertainty。
- 來源未標示 [[Bluetest RTS65]] 規格；不可從本頁推論 chamber frequency range、load condition 或可測 DUT 尺寸。
- 來源未說明 reverberation chamber 測試是否可替代 conformance test、certification test 或 anechoic chamber 測試。

Wi-Fi 8 › 與 R&S CMX500 / CMP180 的關係
[[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 已加入 newly added [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] testing capabilities，並將在 [[MWC Barcelona 2026]] 驗證 [[Broadcom]] prototype [[Wi-Fi 8]] device。

[[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 則在較早 MWC 2024 語境中，把 [[R&S CMP180]] 的 480 MHz [[WLAN]] waveform loopback demonstration 描述為 potential [[Wi-Fi 8]] candidate，並將 [[R&S CMP180]] 定位為 future-proof R&D / production tester。

這兩種說法層次不同：[[R&S CMX500]] 來源是 Wi‑Fi 8 RF signaling tests / prototype device demonstration；[[R&S CMP180]] 來源是 480 MHz waveform loopback / candidate demonstration。

Wi-Fi 8
[[Wi-Fi 8]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 中對 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] amendment 的市場 / 技術稱呼；該來源描述其重點從提高 throughput 轉向 ultra-high reliability（[[UHR]]）connectivity performance。較早的 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 則把 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 稱為 yet-to-be-defined，並提到 wider channel bandwidths are in discussion 與 480 MHz WLAN waveform potential candidate。

⚠️ [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]（MWC 2024；發布日期來源未標示）說 [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 尚未定義，且 even wider channel bandwidths are in discussion，並稱 480 MHz [[WLAN]] waveform 是 potential waveform candidate，但既有頁面 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 說依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] Wi‑Fi 8 保留 up to 320 MHz channel bandwidth。判斷：前者是較早期 discussion / candidate，後者是較晚 PR 的 implemented signaling-test description；先並列，不把 480 MHz 寫成 Wi‑Fi 8 正式規格。

Wi-Fi 8 › 480 MHz waveform candidate 說法
[[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 稱：

- [[R&S CMP180]] supports bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] will demonstrate its ability to verify a [[WLAN]] waveform with **480 MHz bandwidth** in loopback mode。
- 該 480 MHz waveform 被稱為 potential waveform candidate for the yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] standard。

此說法目前只能作為 MWC 2024 PR 的 candidate / discussion 記錄；不得推論 480 MHz 已成為 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 標準通道頻寬。

Wi-Fi 8 › 延續自 Wi-Fi 7 的 core PHY parameters
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]，[[Wi-Fi 8]] 保留下列 [[Wi-Fi 7]] core physical layer parameters：

| 項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| supported frequencies | up to 7.125 GHz |
| channel bandwidth | up to 320 MHz |
| modulation | 4096QAM |
| multi-link | [[MLO]] |

以上是 PR 中對 Wi-Fi 8 的簡述，不等同於完整 IEEE 802.11bn normative specification。

Wi-Fi 8 › 新增 / 強調的 PHY 與 MAC layer technologies
[[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 舉例列出：

- [[distributed resource units]]（dRU）：用於 overcome power spectral density（PSD）limits；dRU measurements 可驗證 uplink transmit power boost 與 connection reliability improvement。
- [[unequal modulation]]（UEQM）：在 difficult reception scenarios 中允許 each [[MIMO]] link 使用 different modulation scheme；UEQM analysis 可評估 device 是否依 specified MCS combinations 正確 adapt modulation。

Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology › 來源定義
依 [[R&S for JIO Project]]：

- WoMT project 的完整描述出現在 slide 1：`Technical Achievements and Measurement Results for JIO WoMT Project`。
- Slide 3 說核心問題是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 原生運作於 2.4 / 5 / 6 GHz，而 27 GHz、n257 / n258 屬 [[3GPP]] mmWave bands。
- Slide 3 說目前缺乏 Wi-Fi operating in mmWave bands 的 established global test standards。
- Slide 4 說 transmission principle 是透過 [[AiP]] modules 將 Wi-Fi 7 signals up-convert 到 27 GHz mmWave band。
- Slide 4 說 device types 包含 Integrated Radio CPEs 與 WoMT-AP（Access Point）。
- Slide 8 提到 test basis 為 `Standard for Wi-Fi over mmWave (n257, n258)`。

依 [[R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3]]：

- 來源未重新定義 WoMT，但在 Jio project RD and manufacturing setup 中明確分出 WIFI IB band 與 WIFI mmWave。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被放在 WIFI IB band / native Wi-Fi testing path。
- [[R&S CMP200]] 與 [[R&S CMPHEAD50]] 被放在 WIFI mmWave path。
- RD site 以 [[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S FSW67]]、[[R&S SMM100A]] 做 Tx / Rx measurement。

Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology › 矛盾與口徑差異
⚠️ [[R&S for JIO Project]]（來源正式日期未標示；raw converted 2026-09-17）說 [[R&S SMM100A]] frequency range up to 67 GHz，但既有頁面 [[R&S SMM100A]] 說 Version 31.00 specifications 的最高 frequency option 為 44 GHz；新來源 [[R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3]]（來源正式日期未標示；raw converted 2026-09-17）在 RD site setup 仍列 [[R&S SMM100A]] as SG，卻在 appendix 以 [[R&S SMA100B]] 列出 8 kHz to 67 GHz。判斷：WoMT 方案材料中的 signal generator 型號 / 規格可能混用，正式頻率範圍須以產品 specifications 為準。

Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology › 使用限制
- [[Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology]] 目前不是由正式標準文件建立的 concept；本頁只反映 [[R&S for JIO Project]] 與 [[R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3]] 的 project-deck 說法。
- `Standard for Wi-Fi over mmWave (n257, n258)` 的版本、發布組織、適用地區、測試項目與認證流程未標示。
- 27 GHz 與 n257 / n258 的關係在來源中未以頻段表定義；不可自行補入 3GPP band tables。
- 來源沒有提供 throughput、range、modulation coding scheme、channel bandwidth、EIRP limit、TRP limit、EIS limit 或 spurious limit 數值。
- Integrated Radio CPEs 與 WoMT-AP 未提供產品型號、供應商、ODM 完整名稱或商用狀態。
- [[R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3]] 的 RD / manufacturing setup 是方案圖與 appendix，不能當作正式 BOM 或 test procedure。

Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology › unresolved
- WoMT 是否為正式標準、草案、Jio internal standard、India-specific regulatory proposal 或 project name 未確認。
- Indian Government 的正式標準化里程碑與 phase-one goal 定義未提供。
- [[SGS]] lab verification 的範圍、報告編號、日期與 authority 未提供。
- [[MediaTek]]、[[Hanwha]]、[[Cyntec]]、[[Renesas]]、[[TMYTek]] 在 WoMT module / chipset / AiP 中的角色未標示。
- [[R&S CMQ200]]、[[R&S AMS32]] 與 automation SW WMT 的 Jio setup 角色未展開。

Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology
[[Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology]]（WoMT）是 [[R&S for JIO Project]] 中使用的技術 / 專案名，指將 [[Wi-Fi 7]] signals 透過 [[AiP]] modules up-convert 到 27 GHz mmWave band，以支援 high-speed transmission；目前只有 Jio project decks 支撐，尚未有正式標準文件或發布組織來源。

Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests
[[Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 中描述的 [[R&S CMX500]] signaling mode 測試能力，用於驗證 prototype [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] WLAN device 的 physical layer features。

Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests › Wi-Fi 8 測試重點
來源描述 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] / [[Wi-Fi 8]] 的重點從 sheer speed 轉向 [[UHR]] performance。相關測試重點包括：

| 測試 / feature | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| [[distributed resource units]] / dRU measurements | 用於驗證 device boosting uplink transmit power 與 improving connection reliability 的 effectiveness；來源提到 dRU 可 overcome PSD limits。 |
| [[unequal modulation]] / UEQM analysis | 在 difficult reception scenarios 中允許 each MIMO link 使用不同 modulation scheme；測試可評估 device 是否以 specified MCS combinations 正確 adapt modulation。 |
| comprehensive signaling mode tests | 來源稱可 cover a broad range of Wi‑Fi 8 features 並執行 in-depth analysis of performance characteristics。 |

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Interworking：WLAN offloading 與 Voice over WLAN
同一來源也把 [[R&S CMX500]] 用於 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 seamless traffic offloading and interworking demonstration：

- [[WLAN offloading]] 是把原本 intended for cellular networks 的 data 透過 WLAN 傳送，以減少 cellular bands data load。
- [[Voice over WLAN]] 情境聚焦在 cellular network 與 WLAN 之間 handover during a voice call，以維持 uninterrupted voice call experience。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway，可測試 WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement function 可用於 voice over WLAN applications 的 quality of experience early-stage 評估。

R&S SMW200A › RF path combination 與 chassis
- RF path combination table：`●` 代表 possible；`–` 代表 not possible；灰底格代表該 RF path combination 需要 `R&S®SMW-B94L` deeper chassis；白底格使用 standard chassis。
- `R&S®SMW-B94L`：Deeper chassis，Order No. `1438.8150.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-B94L` required and only possible for RF path combinations：`2 × 12.75 GHz`、`2 × 31.8 GHz`、`2 × 44 GHz`。
- 44 GHz 組合限制：`R&S®SMW-B1044` 只能與 `R&S®SMW-B2044` 組合；`R&S®SMW-B1044N` 只能與 `R&S®SMW-B2044N` 組合；`R&S®SMW-B1044O` 只能與 `R&S®SMW-B2044O` 組合。

R&S SMW200A › Digital standards、R&S WinIQSIM2、Pulse Sequencer、MIMO 與 fading
- Internal digital modulation systems 至少需安裝一個 `R&S®SMW-B10` 或 `R&S®SMW-B9`。
- 來源列出 cellular、wireless connectivity、navigation、broadcast 與 other standards options；包含 `GSM/EDGE`、`3GPP FDD`、`LTE Release 8` 到 `Release 15`、`Cellular IoT`、`5G New Radio`、`5G NR Release 16/17`、`IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/j/p/ac/ax/be/ad/ay`、`Bluetooth EDR/5.x/5.4`、`GNSS`、`DVB-S2/S2X`、`DVB-RCS2`、`LoRa`、`HRP UWB` 等。
- 來源描述 digital standards 不需要 separate PC software；但 waveform packages for signals from [[R&S WinIQSIM2]] 另明列 [[R&S WinIQSIM2]] requires an external PC。判斷：前者指 instrument internal digital standards，後者指 WinIQSIM2 workflow，不合併為單一規則。
- `R&S®SMW-K144`：5G New Radio，Order No. `1414.4990.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-K145`：5G New Radio closed-loop BS test，Order No. `1414.6506.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-K148`：5G NR Release 16，Order No. `1414.6664.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-K170`：5G NR sidelink，Order No. `1413.8640.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-K171`：5G NR Release 17，Order No. `1413.7280.02`。
- [[R&S WinIQSIM2]] requires an external PC；`R&S®SMW-K200` waveform packages 可登錄 1、5 或 50 waveforms，每台 instrument 最多 `250 waveforms`。
- [[R&S Pulse Sequencer]] 相關 options 包含 `R&S®SMW-K300`、`K301`、`K302`、`K304`、`K306`、`K307`、`K308`、`K315`、`K350`。
- Multichannel、MIMO and fading 完整規格另見 `PD 3673.1276.22`；digital standards 完整規格另見 `PD 5213.9434.22`；GNSS/avionics 另見 `PD 3607.6896.22`；Pulse Sequencer 另見 `PD 3607.1388.22`。

R&S SMW200A › 主要 RF performance（Version 31.00，May 2026）
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]：

- Frequency range：依 RF path frequency option，RF path A 最高 `100 kHz to 67 GHz`；RF path B 最高 `100 kHz to 44 GHz`。
- Overrange：`67 GHz to 72 GHz`。
- Resolution of setting：`0.001 Hz`。
- Resolution of synthesis：`0.053 nHz nominal`，條件 `f = 1 GHz`。

### Answer
The required Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer capability expands mainly in bandwidth, multi-chain/MIMO handling, signaling/real-connection analysis, and feature-specific Wi‑Fi 8 reliability analysis; the passages do not support treating 480 MHz as a formal Wi‑Fi 8 requirement [10][12][57][58][59][66].
| Technology change | Effect on SG / SA measurement capability | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Wi‑Fi 7 increases channel bandwidth to 320 MHz and uses 4096QAM, up to 16 spatial streams, and MLO | SG/SA needs to handle 320 MHz WLAN signals, high-order modulation analysis/generation, and multi-RF-chain / MIMO test setups rather than only single-chain narrowband WLAN testing | Wi‑Fi 7 key elements include 320 MHz channel bandwidth, up to 16 spatial streams, 4096QAM, and MLO; the source says MLO makes a multiple RF chains test environment important [12]. |
| Wi‑Fi 7 R&D testing moves toward signaling mode under real-world conditions | Analyzer/generator platforms need signaling-mode TX/RX RF measurement capability, not only waveform playback or offline analysis | Wi‑Fi 7 R&D testing needs signaling mode and real-world conditions to measure RF TX/RX characteristics [10]. |
| Wi‑Fi 7 production testing emphasizes speed in non-signaling mode | Production SG/SA capability needs fast non-signaling RF measurement, scalable analyzers/generators, RF port density, and MIMO scaling | In production, all RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time; CMP180 is described with two analyzers, two generators, two sets of eight RF ports for 2x2 MIMO, and two CMP180 units can scale to four analyzers/generators for 4x4 MIMO AP testing [67]. |
| Wi‑Fi 8 adds reliability-oriented PHY/MAC features such as dRU and UEQM | Analyzer capability must include feature-specific signaling analysis: dRU measurements for uplink transmit power boost / reliability behavior and UEQM analysis for per-MIMO-link modulation and specified MCS-combination adaptation | dRU measurements verify uplink transmit power boost and connection reliability improvement; UEQM analysis evaluates whether the device correctly adapts modulation according to specified MCS combinations [59][66]. |
| Early Wi‑Fi 8 discussion included a 480 MHz WLAN waveform candidate | 480 MHz / 500 MHz-class bandwidth is only an R&D or future-proofing consideration in the cited material, not a confirmed Wi‑Fi 8 conformance requirement | CMP180 was said to support bandwidths up to 500 MHz and demonstrate a 480 MHz WLAN waveform in loopback mode as a potential Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn candidate, but the passage says this must not be treated as a formal Wi‑Fi 8 standard channel bandwidth [57]. |
【推論】For Wi‑Fi 7/8 baseband/RF work, the practical SG/SA bandwidth floor moves to 320 MHz, while 480 MHz should be treated only as exploratory because Wi‑Fi 7 lists 320 MHz and Wi‑Fi 8 retains up to 320 MHz, whereas 480 MHz is only a potential candidate waveform [12][58][57].
【推論】For MLO and MIMO work, SG/SA setups need multiple synchronized RF chains or scalable analyzer/generator resources because Wi‑Fi 7 identifies MLO as making multiple RF chains important, and production testing cites 2x2 and scalable 4x4 analyzer/generator configurations [10][67].
【推論】For Wi‑Fi 8, the added measurement burden is less about a proven wider channel and more about signaling analysis of reliability features, because the cited Wi‑Fi 8 passages retain 320 MHz but add dRU and UEQM measurement/analysis requirements [58][59][66].

cited_passages.text:
Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術挑戰
來源將 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 描述為 designed for extremely high data throughput，面向 tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。來源列出的 higher throughput key elements：

| 技術項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| channel bandwidth | increased channel bandwidth of 320 MHz |
| spatial streams | up to 16 spatial streams |
| modulation | 4096 QAM modulation |
| MLO | key feature；使 multiple RF chains 測試環境變重要 |

Wi-Fi 8 › 480 MHz waveform candidate 說法
[[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 稱：

- [[R&S CMP180]] supports bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] will demonstrate its ability to verify a [[WLAN]] waveform with **480 MHz bandwidth** in loopback mode。
- 該 480 MHz waveform 被稱為 potential waveform candidate for the yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] standard。

此說法目前只能作為 MWC 2024 PR 的 candidate / discussion 記錄；不得推論 480 MHz 已成為 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 標準通道頻寬。

Wi-Fi 8 › 延續自 Wi-Fi 7 的 core PHY parameters
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]，[[Wi-Fi 8]] 保留下列 [[Wi-Fi 7]] core physical layer parameters：

| 項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| supported frequencies | up to 7.125 GHz |
| channel bandwidth | up to 320 MHz |
| modulation | 4096QAM |
| multi-link | [[MLO]] |

以上是 PR 中對 Wi-Fi 8 的簡述，不等同於完整 IEEE 802.11bn normative specification。

Wi-Fi 8 › 新增 / 強調的 PHY 與 MAC layer technologies
[[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 舉例列出：

- [[distributed resource units]]（dRU）：用於 overcome power spectral density（PSD）limits；dRU measurements 可驗證 uplink transmit power boost 與 connection reliability improvement。
- [[unequal modulation]]（UEQM）：在 difficult reception scenarios 中允許 each [[MIMO]] link 使用 different modulation scheme；UEQM analysis 可評估 device 是否依 specified MCS combinations 正確 adapt modulation。

Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests › Wi-Fi 8 測試重點
來源描述 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] / [[Wi-Fi 8]] 的重點從 sheer speed 轉向 [[UHR]] performance。相關測試重點包括：

| 測試 / feature | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| [[distributed resource units]] / dRU measurements | 用於驗證 device boosting uplink transmit power 與 improving connection reliability 的 effectiveness；來源提到 dRU 可 overcome PSD limits。 |
| [[unequal modulation]] / UEQM analysis | 在 difficult reception scenarios 中允許 each MIMO link 使用不同 modulation scheme；測試可評估 device 是否以 specified MCS combinations 正確 adapt modulation。 |
| comprehensive signaling mode tests | 來源稱可 cover a broad range of Wi‑Fi 8 features 並執行 in-depth analysis of performance characteristics。 |

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。
